status: ACTIVE — consumed by part_context_resolver.py to emit applicable_rule_behaviors per part.
note: rule_id -> the actionable behavior a part must follow, the check that proves it, and authority. Turns 'rule applies' into 'here is what this part must do'. Covers every KEEP RULE/RECIPE/NEGATIVE.

AUTHORITATIVE_SNAP_PLACEMENT_PROTOCOL.required_behavior: Use validated snap-group placement for snap-enrolled parts; do not free-place when a snap relationship exists.
AUTHORITATIVE_SNAP_PLACEMENT_PROTOCOL.check: snap nature + group_label present in packet; placement matches snap tier

PLACEMENT_PRECEDENCE_RESOLUTION_PROCEDUR.required_behavior: Resolve placement by the precedence ladder; assembly context supersedes component context; the highest data-backed tier wins.

PART_PLACEMENT_MAP_SCHEMA.required_behavior: Place from the verified part map (SNAP_VALIDATED/GOLD tiers) where available; otherwise use the documented non-snap derivation.
PART_PLACEMENT_MAP_SCHEMA.check: partmap coverage / tier present in packet

VERIFIED_PARTMAP_DATA_PROTOCOL.required_behavior: Use the verified Builder-spawn extraction overlay as component-placement evidence; verified fields outrank unverified geometry.
VERIFIED_PARTMAP_DATA_PROTOCOL.check: placement cites verified partmap fields where they exist

CONNECTED_PIECE_CURVATURE_GRAMMAR.required_behavior: For curved shells/domes/spires, follow the chord/ring grammar; do not stamp parts independently along a curve.
CONNECTED_PIECE_CURVATURE_GRAMMAR.check: ring chord <= limit; transform propagation present

DOME_STUDY_LESSONS.required_behavior: Build domes from radius-tapering rings (DOME_RADIAL_RING_TAPER); constant-radius vertical rings make a cylinder, not a dome.
DOME_STUDY_LESSONS.check: dome ring radii taper per the recorded method

WALL_SHELL_ENCLOSURE_RECIPE.required_behavior: For any building/tower/room/city block/enclosure, build a continuous wall shell; never assemble enclosures from loose wall panels.
WALL_SHELL_ENCLOSURE_RECIPE.check: enclosure is a continuous shell; no loose panels or unplanned gaps

CONTINUOUS_PATH_ASSEMBLY_RULE.required_behavior: For any bridge/tube/pipe/cable/rail/corridor/repeated connector spanning endpoints, place a continuous endpoint-to-endpoint segment chain.
CONTINUOUS_PATH_ASSEMBLY_RULE.check: path segments connect endpoints with no gaps

DISCONNECTED_ASSEMBLY_HARDSTOP_RULE.required_behavior: Connected assemblies must have no unplanned floating or disconnected segments before delivery.
DISCONNECTED_ASSEMBLY_HARDSTOP_RULE.check: connectivity / no-float gate on exported build

FOCAL_BUILD_GEOMETRY_STRATEGY_PROTOCOL.required_behavior: Design the geometric object/silhouette first, then populate with parts; part usage alone does not validate a focal build.
FOCAL_BUILD_GEOMETRY_STRATEGY_PROTOCOL.check: a geometry/silhouette plan precedes part population

C_TRIFLOOR_EDGE_CONTACT_GRAPH_PROTOCOL.required_behavior: For freeform C_TRIFLOOR beyond validated regular shapes, build the edge-contact graph (triangles share edges in contact) before placement.
C_TRIFLOOR_EDGE_CONTACT_GRAPH_PROTOCOL.check: edge-contact graph present; shared-edge contact verified

STAIR_PLACEMENT_DOCTRINE.required_behavior: Place stairs by the canonical stair doctrine (endpoint recipe + corner transitions); do not eyeball stair landings.

SPACING_CONNECTION_SCALE_RULES.required_behavior: Apply validated spacing/connection/scale (e.g., step = native_size x scale x 0.92); connected pieces must touch or overlap.
SPACING_CONNECTION_SCALE_RULES.check: spacing formula honored; no unintended gaps

GROUND_ZERO_FOUNDATION_RULE.required_behavior: For large procedural builds on unknown/uneven/steep/floating terrain, establish a ground-zero foundation datum before vertical placement.

PART_ORIENTATION_OVERRIDES.required_behavior: rx=90 is a default, not universal; apply the validated per-ObjectID orientation override when one exists (e.g., S_LARGETRYE0).
PART_ORIENTATION_OVERRIDES.check: orientation matches the override registry for any listed ObjectID

AIRLOCK_IRIS_EXACT_JSON_RECIPE_RULE.required_behavior: For radial airlock/iris assemblies, use the known-good exact JSON control recipe directly; do not infer a new per-piece radial orientation model.
AIRLOCK_IRIS_EXACT_JSON_RECIPE_RULE.check: airlock/iris transforms come from the exact recipe, not derived

PROHIBITED_AND_PLACEHOLDER_OBJECTS.required_behavior: Do not place prohibited/placeholder ObjectIDs or apply unapproved non-uniform final scale; pipe/BUBPIPE connectors require in-game/JSON validation.
PROHIBITED_AND_PLACEHOLDER_OBJECTS.check: prohibited ObjectID scan = 0; non-uniform scale scan = 0

WORKING_JSON_FIRST_PRINCIPLE.required_behavior: When relevant working exported NMS JSON exists, treat it as top-priority evidence and use it before screenshots, memory, or generic rotation assumptions.
WORKING_JSON_FIRST_PRINCIPLE.check: working JSON consulted before placement when available

VALIDATION_GATE_HARDENING_RULE.required_behavior: A generated script is validated only when the executable gate proves it ran, created nonzero objects, and did not misuse NMS Builder Part wrappers.
VALIDATION_GATE_HARDENING_RULE.check: run_gate executable proof: objects>0, no wrapper misuse

BLENDER_PARITY_RULE.required_behavior: A live-Blender build (BUILDER.add_part/transform) is governed by the same procedure and gates as a generated script.
BLENDER_PARITY_RULE.check: live-build path uses templates + same gates

COMPOSITE_BUILD_INTENT_GRAPH_PROTOCOL.required_behavior: For composite/large builds, supply a BUILD_INTENT_GRAPH; a no-float pass does not prove the requested build is correct.
COMPOSITE_BUILD_INTENT_GRAPH_PROTOCOL.check: BUILD_INTENT_GRAPH present + connected-component verification on exported JSON

CURATED_DETAIL_HIERARCHY_RULE.required_behavior: Author detail with hierarchy (focal > secondary > tertiary); do not scatter props evenly.
CURATED_DETAIL_HIERARCHY_RULE.check: detail density follows a hierarchy, not uniform scatter

UNIVERSAL_RULES.required_behavior: Use real NMS parts via BUILDER.add_part templates and duplicate them; no raw Blender primitives as build parts.
UNIVERSAL_RULES.check: no raw primitives; add_part templates used
